# Jávea Bliss — apartment for sale

Jávea Bliss is a renovated, furnished apartment for sale in El Arenal, Jávea / Xàbia, Alicante, Spain. It is offered as a second home. It is not currently available for rental or holiday bookings.

## Property
- 80 m² built area, 2 double bedrooms, 1 bathroom.
- First floor with lift, covered balcony, separate laundry area.
- Approximately 250 metres from Arenal Beach. Restaurants and shops within walking distance.
- Furniture, household appliances and equipment included according to the final sale inventory.
- Owner-only communal parking; spaces are not individually allocated and availability is not guaranteed.

- Contact and viewings: admin@javeabliss.com. Agencies may collaborate without exclusivity; terms agreed with the owner.
